## Purpose
The actions in flight on every page: what each is doing now, how far it has measurably got, and how long it has taken. It sits above dialogs.

## Responsibilities
- `ActivityTray` reads `stores/ops` and `RunNotices` (background synthesis runs).
- `OpCard` shows the label (`describeRequest`), the activity (`opActivity` / `opDetail`), the progress and the elapsed time (`useNow`).
- `rows` orders the entries.

## Key elements
`ActivityTray`.

## Control flow
React rendering; data through React Query hooks where noted.

## Data, state and side effects
None beyond component state.

## Configuration
None.

## Interactions
- Mounted in the app shell. Uses `lib/ops/describe`, `runs/runMeta` and `lib/runs/synthesis`.

## Error handling and edge cases
None noted.

## Nuances and gotchas
- **Closing a card only hides it;** the request carries on.
